title: MILO Marathon Dipolog Leg 2026 Review: Zamboanga Qualifier
seo_title: MILO Marathon Dipolog Leg 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: National MILO Marathon 2026 Dipolog City Leg: August 16. RUNRIO's series qualifier in Zamboanga del Norte.
dek: Set for 16 August 2026 in Dipolog City, this RUNRIO-produced MILO Marathon qualifying leg brings the series to the Zamboanga peninsula.
verdict: The MILO Marathon Dipolog Leg is a RUNRIO-produced MILO series qualifier in Dipolog City — the capital of Zamboanga del Norte on Mindanao's northwestern coast. Five distances from 1K to 21K. Dipolog is known for its Sunset Boulevard and its sardine industry. RUNRIO's production ensures professional standards. August in Zamboanga is relatively dry. A MILO series qualifier in one of Mindanao's less-travelled provinces.
